description: This Java class defines a REST controller for managing 'Client' resources in a web application. It includes endpoints for CRUD operations such as retrieving a client or all clients, creating, updating, and deleting clients, utilizing Spring Boot annotations for request mapping and validation.

classes.name: ClientResource
classes.description: REST controller class for handling client-related API requests, incorporating dependency injection for client and user services, with endpoints for CRUD operations.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a client by its ID.

methods.name: getClients
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all clients.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a client by its ID.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new client associated with a user email.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing client associated with a user email.
